ARABIC — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Conversational skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Conversational skills.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

3. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose
